controles.affirmation: La Cour supreme americaine a juge le 20 fevrier 2026 que les tarifs IEEPA etaient ILLEGAUX
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T3 FY2026 : "On February 20, 2026, the U.S. Supreme Court ruled that the tariffs previously imposed under the International Emergency Economic Powers Act (“IEEPA”) were unauthorized. As a result of this ruling, we may be eligible for a refund of tariffs previously paid on imported goods. As the recoverability and timing of any such refund remains uncertain, we have not recorded a benefit for any potential refund and will not until such amounts are realizable. We will continue to monitor these developments and believe that any potential refund will not have a material impact on our business and Consolidated Financial Statements."
controles.correction_proposee: Le document dit "were unauthorized" (non autorises, faute de base legale), pas "illegal". Ecrire : "a juge le 20 fevrier 2026 que les tarifs imposes au titre de l'IEEPA n'etaient pas autorises". Ajouter aussi la reserve de Cisco, omise par l'ATT : la societe estime qu'un eventuel remboursement n'aura pas d'impact significatif.

controles.affirmation: Cisco a tenu 64,4% de marge brute produit sur l'ENSEMBLE de l'exercice FY2025
controles.verbatim_source: 10-K FY2025, tableau de reconciliation de la marge brute produit : "Fiscal 2024 63.5 % / Productivity 2.0 % / Product pricing (1.6) % / Mix of products sold 1.1 % / Legal dispute with supplier (0.8) % / Amortization of purchased intangible assets (0.4) % / Others (0.1) % / Fiscal 2025 63.7 %" ; et "Product gross margin increased by 0.2 percentage points"
controles.correction_proposee: Sur l'exercice complet FY2025 la marge brute produit est de 63,7%, pas 64,4%. Le 64,4% est la marge du T3 FY2025 et des 9 mois FY2025, periode de comparaison du 10-Q. Ecrire : "Cisco affichait 64,4% de marge brute produit au T3 FY2025 et 63,7% sur l'ensemble de FY2025".
